::: {.library-intro}

A collection of books I've read, am reading, and hope to read.

Browse my reading history or explore the books on my reading wishlist.

:::

```{r}
#| include: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

source("R/localization_helpers.R")
source("R/library_helpers.R")

library_data <- prepare_library(lang = "en")
```

## Reading Library

Books I'm currently reading, have finished, or have set aside.

::: {.library-page}

```{r}
#| echo: false

render_library_table(
  library_data$reading,
  lang = "en",
  type = "reading"
)
```

:::

## Want to Read

Books I'd like to read in the future.

::: {.library-page}

```{r}
#| echo: false

render_library_table(
  library_data$wishlist,
  lang = "en",
  type = "wishlist"
)
```

:::
